$description: Sampo's design system (SAMPO.md, Design: the illustrated forge, design direction 12, T-2850). The one source the site, the pane and statusline, the fm code TUI theme, Desktop, README diagrams and share images read. brand holds the six materials; light and dark map them to roles, and components use roles only. Forge light and ember are fire, never a status: status hues sit 30 degrees or more from both. Proved by plugin/tests/test_sampo_design.py.

forge-light.$description: the fire's gold, the seam's heat and the lit runes; on iron or the night only

hammered-bronze.$description: engraved brass: rules, ticks, the night's kickers; graphics and display, not body text

iron.$description: the anvil, the band and the stone's dark facets

parchment.$description: the daylight ground, a pale dawn sky

blueprint.$description: the night the forge burns in

blueprint-line.$description: the fire's blue root and the algiz rune

ember.$description: sparks, the kaun rune and the one live point; never a fill larger than a rune

light.$description: Daylight: the forge seen at dawn, ink on a pale sky.

stone.$description: the iron the mark is forged in; glow and ember sit on it

accent.$description: links, the one primary action, the selection: the fire's blue in ink

bronze.$description: kickers, rules, headings and the mark's star in brass

glow.$description: forge light, on iron surfaces only

ember.$description: sparks; graphics, never text on the day

chart.$description: six categorical series for charts on the raised panel, the fire's colours in ink: gold, blue, red, green, violet, orange; 3:1 or better on raised, neighbours 40 degrees apart in hue (T-2757)

dark.$description: Night: the forge burning under the stars.

stone.$description: the iron the mark is forged in, a step above the night

accent.$description: pale brass: links, the one primary action, the selection, the mark's star

bronze.$description: kickers, rules and headings in engraved brass

chart.$description: the fire's own six colours on the night panel

display.$description: a high-contrast modern serif for the word and headlines, 420 at large optical size; the italic carries taglines. OFL; the logo files carry it outlined

mono.$description: wide and engraved: kickers, commands, numbers, labels; tabular figures

motion.$description: The UI tokens are motion.md's; the mark's motion is the forge: the fire burns, the hammer strikes and throws sparks, the runes kindle and the rivets heat in turn, then it rests. Every autoplay ends within autoplay-limit and rests on the still; a loop runs only while work runs (the pane glyph) or under the pointer.

rune.$description: one rune kindling; runes follow each other by this step

strike.$description: one hammer blow: raised, wound up, struck, recovered
the hammer's fall: slow off the top, fastest at the face

autoplay-limit.$description: WCAG 2.2.2: motion that starts on its own ends by here

reduced.$description: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-motion="reduce") drops every animation to none and shows the still: the hammer raised, the fire at rest, no sparks or glows. Colour and opacity changes of 150ms or less stay.
